messages:
laura: Quick ask 1 1 Wee28099re planning a Gratitude Kit kiosk + Tile Wall at the offsite on Jun 14. Want to set up same-day spot-awards ($25 e-gifts + small pickup token) and ship kits to remote folks. Need volunteers, vendor recs, shipping approach, and tax/payroll checks. Who can help?

mateo: Ie28099ll take physical logistics (table layout, tape, signage) and shipping labels. Cane28099t do shipping quotes until I know headcount. Need final list by Jun 7.

priya: Budget question: does this come out of the Q2 culture allowance or central events? If culture, use code Q2-CULTURE-01. Also will ask procurement for bulk e-gift options around $25.

jen: Payroll/tax heads-up: for employees, even small awards require ledger entry; under de minimis threshold but still track. For contractors, need signed consent to receive gift cards; may be non-wage. I will confirm exact docs by EOD Fri.

peopleops-bot: PAYROLL DEADLINE: To include vendor gift cards in June expenses, upload vendor invoices by 2024-06-09 17:00 PT.

frank: Shipping for remote: yes, please. Can we do an e-gift plus a tiny physical token (sticker/pin) for pickup at the kiosk to reduce lost-mail risk?

laura: Love that. Mateo, can you make a shipping-address template we can paste into the registration form? Priya, confirm budget source. Jen, confirm payroll steps & contractor consent doc. Sasha, draft nomination form fields.

mateo: Shipping template for form (copy/paste):

```
Full name: <first last>\nStreet address: <line 1>\nApt/Suite (optional): <line 2>\nCity: <city>\nState/Region: <state>\nPostal code: <zip>\nCountry: <country>\nPreferred phone (optional): <phone>\n```

sasha: Nomination form fields idea: "Nominee name", "Nominee team", "Brief reason (1-2 sentences)", "Send spot award? (yes/no)", "Award amount (preset $25)", "Public wall shoutout? (opt-in)", "Shipping address (if remote)", "Manager approval confirmed (checkbox for >$50)". Also an opt-in for event photos.

priya: Vendor shortlist: EgiftHub, Cardful, GiftSprint. Ie28099ll request quotes and confirm integration for bulk e-mails by Jun 4. Preference for e-gift + physical token for pickup as Frank suggested.

jen: Confirmed: employees e28094 taxable ledger entry; de minimis applies but still logged. Contractors e28094 need written consent; Ie28099ll draft a one-line consent to attach to registration and confirm whether we treat as non-wage. Ie28099ll update by Jun 5.

peopleops-bot: REMINDER: tax-team@redwood needs final awardee list by 2024-06-11 for month-end reconciliation.

laura: Action items + deadlines:
- Mateo: final shipping template + kiosk table layout photo (due Jun 3)
- Priya: vendor quotes + procurement request (due Jun 4)
- Jen: payroll/contractor guidance + consent snippet (due Jun 5)
- Sasha: nomination form copy + embed for RSVP (due Jun 6)
- Laura: signage, tile print vendor, volunteer schedule (Ie28099ll coordinate)

frank: I can volunteer midday at the kiosk. Will help run the pickup table.

mateo: Volunteers so far: laura (setup), mateo (setup/shipping), frank (kiosk midday), sasha (teardown). Need 1e280932 more for teardown and one floater.

sasha: Ie28099ll do teardown shift.

priya: Procurement prefers e-gift + small physical token kit for pickup. Will push for vendor with CSV upload and tracking.

laura: Can someone write a short 1-2 sentence blurb for the all-hands and an internal calendar event blurb? Post drafts here and Ie28099ll publish.

mateo: Draft blurb: "Gratitude Wall + Spot-Award Kiosk e28094 join us Jun 14 at the offsite 12:00-2:00pm to celebrate teammates. Nominate colleagues for same-day spot awards and pick up tokens on the spot. Remote teammates: indicate shipping address on the form and wee28099ll ship kits. Nominate by Jun 7: <form link>"

jen: +1. Maybe add: "Gift cards issued electronically; small tokens available for pickup."

laura: Perfect. Everyone, please update the shared doc with progress. Wee28099ll reconvene Jun 5 for a final checklist call. Thanks :sparkles: :heart:
